name: raycast-aerospace
title: AeroSpace
description: Move windows between AeroSpace workspaces and switch workspaces, right from Raycast.
author: enengee

commands.name: move-window-to-workspace
commands.title: Move Window to Workspace
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Pick or create a workspace to move the focused window to.

commands.name: switch-to-workspace
commands.title: Switch to Workspace
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Fuzzy-search your workspaces and switch to one.

commands.name: rename-workspace
commands.title: Rename Current Workspace
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Rename the focused workspace by moving its windows to a new name.

commands.name: summon-workspace
commands.title: Bring Workspace to This Monitor
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Summon a workspace (by name) to the currently focused monitor.

preferences.name: aerospacePath
preferences.title: AeroSpace Binary Path
preferences.description: Full path to the aerospace binary. Run 'which aerospace' to find it.
